title: In Beginning, Part 2 — title slide with the presenter
summary: Title slide for part 2 of the lesson on the beginning (Genesis 1:1): a video still of the presenter sitting in front of a wall world map, with a large green number 2 and the words "In Beginning, Part 2".

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter, a man with glasses and short grey hair in a white T-shirt, sitting on a brown couch and speaking with both hands open. Behind him a large wall map of the world (Africa, South America and the Indian Ocean visible). Green title text "2" and "In Beginning, Part 2" overlaid at the bottom.
pictures.text_in_picture: 2 In Beginning, Part 2 (a small logo on the shirt is partly legible: CAFE PATTAYA)
